_doc: Mocap -> R15 clips. file: under build/mocap/src; frames: source frame range (take 0-based) the loop/one-shot is cut from; fps: real capture fps (CMU 62_* is 60 although its header says 120); cycle: loop length bounds in s; root: bob (offsets around the mean, in place) | abs (real hip height, sit); root_y: extra studs; native: take already loops, used whole; wrap: native take without a duplicate end frame (frame b samples frame a); upper: upper body only (layers over walk/idle); yaw: extra facing turn in degrees. Stylize (rotations only, R15 limb lengths kept; degrees in AnimKit CFrame.Angles order, +x swings a limb forward and tilts Waist/Neck back): upright: 0-1 (or per part LowerTorso/UpperTorso/Head) scales the part's world tilt toward vertical, arms keep their world direction; amp: {joint: k} scales the joint's motion around its mean; offset: {joint: [x,y,z]} pre-rotates it in its parent frame; pose: {joint: [x,y,z]} replaces it; smooth: gaussian sigma in 30 fps frames (default 0.8); repeat: loop the cut cycle n times (still takes, room for slow sway); sway: [[joint, x, y, z, cycles per loop, phase]] seamless sine layers (loops only).
